data.title: Global stocks rally as investors shrug off U.S. tariffs and AI jitters to 'fish for bargains'
data.description: Investors appeared to have shrugged off a fresh set of tariffs unveiled by the White House on Wednesday, targeting more than a dozen major trading partners.
data.author: Chloe Taylor,Lee Ying Shan
